# Techy Pwint

> Techy Pwint is Pwint San's business. Pwint San helps Myanmar business owners use websites, AI and automation to work smarter and grow online, and teaches them how to do it themselves. Services cover business websites, e-commerce stores, landing pages, AI workflows, custom Claude skills and AI chatbots. Work is available in English, Burmese and Thai.

Pwint San is a website and AI automation specialist based in Thailand who works remotely with Myanmar businesses. Pwint San holds an MBA in Marketing Management and a UI/UX Design Certification from Springboard, co-founded the web design studio Site Digital (https://pwintsan4238.github.io/sitedigital/), has designed and built 40+ websites, designed chatbots and Messenger marketing for 90+ SMEs, and created ShweApps, a Burmese-language Android app for Myanmar people in Thailand with 1K+ downloads (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mycompany.shweapps).

## Websites

- [Business website with SEO, AEO and video ads](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#websites-services): $600–1,000. A custom mobile-friendly website of up to 5 pages, SEO and answer engine optimization for AI assistants, plus 2–3 short video ads. Takes 2–4 weeks.
- [E-commerce website](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#websites-services): from 500,000–2,000,000 MMK. Product pages, cart, checkout and payment gateway integration.
- [Landing page](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#websites-services): from 500,000–2,000,000 MMK. One focused page for a launch, event or ad campaign.
- Website redesigns: improve an existing site's content, structure and SEO.

## AI & Automation

- [AI Workflow for Business](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#ai-services): $400–800. Automates repetitive work such as content, scheduling, customer messages and reports, with 2 weeks of support. Takes 1–2 weeks.
- [Custom Claude Skill](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#ai-services): $150–400. Teaches the AI a business's brand, products and rules so results are consistent. Takes about 3–7 days.
- [AI Chatbot](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#ai-services): from 500,000–2,000,000 MMK. Answers customers in Burmese, Thai or English on Messenger, Instagram, website chat or Telegram.
- [AI Workflow for Creators & Personal Brands](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#ai-services): $200–400.

## Learn

- [Myanmar Business Digital Starter Kit](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#free): free, coming soon. Website and AI checklists, templates and prompts for business owners.
- [AI Video Creation Course](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#learn-services): $100–150, coming soon.
- [Niche Finding & Content Strategy](https://pwintsan4238.github.io/#free): free session for creators.

Bundles get a discount. Payment is 50% upfront and 50% on delivery.
